assets.name: league-gold.png
assets.prompt:
Premium 3D mobile game league badge, AAA quality, like a high-end ranked-mode emblem. Polished real metal with
crisp bevels and sharp specular highlights, deep glossy enamel, small cut gems that catch the light, a thin
bright rim light along the top edges, soft ambient occlusion in the recesses. Bright, rich and clean, never
dark, dirty or muddy. One single object, perfectly symmetrical, centred, facing straight at the camera
(orthographic front view, no tilt), filling about 85% of the frame. Transparent background, no cast shadow,
no floor, no glow halo outside the object. Original design, not based on any existing game or brand. No text,
no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark.

A heraldic shield badge in polished warm yellow gold with a thick rounded rim, its face a deep royal blue
enamel. In the middle sits a big faceted gold five-pointed star with a round ruby set in its centre. A small
gold crown with three pearl-tipped points sits on top of the shield, and two swept gold wings spread from its
upper sides. Small sapphires are set along the rim. Triumphant, precious and celebratory.

Use case: stylized-concept. Single isolated 1024x1024 square league badge, genuine transparent background. The whole shield, crown and BOTH wings must fit fully inside the frame, with a consistent clear margin on every side. All components form one connected, front-facing, bilaterally symmetric silhouette. Exactly three pearl-tipped crown points. No glow or colored haze outside the metal.

The same badge as the reference image, with exactly the same shield shape, crown, wings, proportions and
camera, remade in polished cool bright silver instead of gold. Its face is a steel blue enamel. In the
middle, instead of the star, are two thick bevelled silver chevrons pointing upward. Small clear crystals
are set along the rim instead of sapphires. Cleaner and plainer than the gold one, but still premium.

Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT THE ATTACHED GOLD BADGE IN PLACE. This attached image is both the edit target and exact geometry reference. Keep the canvas dimensions, exact outer alpha silhouette, all shield edges, crown and pearl shapes, every wing feather, all positions and proportions absolutely unchanged. Change ONLY materials and the internal face insignia: replace all gold metal with bright polished cool silver; replace royal-blue face enamel with steel-blue enamel; replace sapphires with colorless clear crystals. Remove central star and ruby and put exactly two bold stacked upward-pointing silver chevrons inside the same shield face. Retain original pearl tips. Do not redraw outer geometry, zoom, rotate, reposition, add outline, glow, floor or background. Preserve genuine transparency around the badge.

assets.name: avatar-you.png
assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer. Edit the attached cartoon profile avatar. Preserve this same recognizable youthful fictional character: tousled short brown hair, warm brown eyes, subtle freckles, friendly confident grin, premium soft rounded 3D animation rendering. Change the pose decisively to a STRICTLY STRAIGHT-ON FRONTAL PORTRAIT: head upright with zero tilt, zero yaw and zero roll, eyes level and looking directly into camera, nose and chin on the vertical centerline, both ears equally visible, shoulders level and square to camera. Do not retain the original tilted three-quarter pose. Change clothing to tasteful futuristic sci-fi techwear: a yellow-and-graphite structured technical jacket with a neat raised collar, subtle armored shoulder panels and thin restrained cyan luminous seams. High quality clean materials, approachable futuristic game-player look; no helmet, mask or eyewear obstructing the face. Keep face large and readable at small avatar size. Head and shoulders perfectly centered inside a perfect circular backdrop filling the square, soft sunny golden-yellow gradient with a subtle cool accent near the bottom. Keep all character details inside the circle. Everything outside the circle must be genuinely transparent with clean smooth edges, no stray pixels. No border ring, no writing, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no UI graphics. One square avatar only.
